item.title: The King of Fighters stars are crossing over to... PUBG Mobile?
item.description: <p>Crossovers are still all the rage in the fighting game scene right now, and that includes a bunch of properties sitting far outside of the genre.</p> <p>Krafton recently announced and launched their latest collaboration for PUBG Mobile with The King of Fighters.</p>

item.title: Frosty Faustings champion releases both character and team tier lists for 2XKO after winning first big major
item.description: <p>After finally launching in full last month, 2XKO just had its first big offline major tournament this past weekend at <a href="https://www.eventhubs.com/news/2026/jan/25/frosty-faustings-xviii-2026-results/">Frosty Faustings XVIII</a>.</p> <p>Out of more than 850 players who signed up, ONi|<a href="https://x.com/bleedBTW/status/2019195312301322346">Bleed</a> was the one to walk away victorious in the League of Legends fighter.</p>

item.title: PlayStation's Critics' Choice sale offers up Tekken 8, Street Fighter 6 DLC, Mortal Kombat 1 and plenty more fighting game deals
item.description: <p><a href="https://www.eventhubs.com/news/2026/jan/08/2026-fighting-games-guide/">2026 is shaping up to be a very busy year for fighting game fans</a>, and you can save a chunk of money on the biggest titles around right now.</p> <p>PlayStation is currently running both Critics' Choice and Hot Deals sales that are offering up quite a few nice fighter discounts worth checking out.</p>

item.title: Capcom's updated best-selling rankings reveal Street Fighter 6 ahead of Street fighter 2, Marvel vs Capcom collection boost
item.description: <p>While many studios across the video game industry have been struggling at least a bit as of late, Capcom is continuing to steamroll forward ahead with high sales.</p> <p>Capcom just updated their <a href="https://www.capcom.co.jp/ir/english/business/million.html#tab2">Platinum Titles list</a> of their best-selling video games, and some of their fighting games saw a boost <a href="https://www.eventhubs.com/news/2025/nov/06/capcom-updated-fighter-sales/">over their previous report</a>.</p>
